basic_profile.bio: I’m a 26-year-old graphic designer living in Austin, TX. I’ve recently gotten into Rocket League and I’m loving the community. I spend my evenings and weekends gaming or watching the latest season of The Bachelor. I’m single and enjoy exploring different gaming genres, especially indie games. My work keeps me busy during the day, so I’m mostly online during late evenings. I’m also intrigued by unconventional philosophies, which is why I occasionally browse the Church of Satan subreddit.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in graphic design, with a degree from the University of Texas. My gaming knowledge is mostly self-taught, often learning through YouTube tutorials and community discussions. I’m fairly new to Rocket League, so I’m still catching up with the game's mechanics and meta.
